notes: A centered white page with the Notion cube, the heading 'Your AI workspace. Log in to your Notion account' and a focused email field with a hint to use an organization email. A blue Continue button leads to an 'or continue with' grid of six labelled tiles: Google, ChatGPT, Apple, Microsoft, Passkey and SSO. A sign-up link, terms text, a language selector and a help icon complete the page. It does not name the requesting app or list permissions.
